sql_evidence.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW op_source AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/staging/operational-domains-completion-v1/joint-v1/production_issue.parquet'))
SELECT min("DocDate") AS first_observed_date,max("DocDate") AS last_observed_date,count(*) AS dataset_rows FROM op_source
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE op_period AS SELECT * FROM op_source WHERE "DocDate">=? AND "DocDate"<?

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW op_eligible_groups AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/staging/operational-domains-completion-v1/joint-v1/observed_material_actual_consumption.parquet'))

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW op_orders AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/staging/operational-domains-completion-v1/joint-v1/production_order.parquet'))

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE op_consumption AS SELECT I.* FROM op_period I
                    WHERE I."CANCELED"='N' AND cast(I."BaseType" AS DECIMAL(18,6))=202 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM op_orders O WHERE O."DocEntry"=I."BaseEntry")
                        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM op_eligible_groups E WHERE E.item_code=I."ItemCode"
                        AND E.native_unit_msr IS NOT DISTINCT FROM I."unitMsr"
                        AND E.native_uom_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM I."UomCode"
                        AND E.native_num_per_msr IS NOT DISTINCT FROM I."NumPerMsr")

SELECT "ItemCode" AS item_code,"unitMsr" AS unit,"UomCode" AS uom_code,
                    "NumPerMsr" AS native_factor,count(*) AS issue_lines,
                    sum(cast("Quantity" AS DECIMAL(38,12))) AS quantity
                    FROM op_consumption GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY unit NULLS LAST,uom_code NULLS LAST,native_factor NULLS LAST,quantity DESC,item_code

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM op_period) AS period_source_lines,
                    count(*) AS included_issue_lines FROM op_consumption
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE op_unknown(doc_entry BIGINT,line_num BIGINT)

SELECT count(*) FROM op_consumption I
                    JOIN op_unknown U ON I."DocEntry"=U.doc_entry AND I."LineNum"=U.line_num
